record.FullBody:
REGISTER TODAY! go.rowan.edu/2026WanConference 

The Women's Alliance Network (WAN) is excited to have you join us for  on March 9th! Get ready for an empowering day of conversations, practical strategies, and networking opportunities designed to help you identify what’s holding you back — and move confidently toward your next level.

Kicking Off the Conference

We are honored to have Provost Vojislava “Voki” Pophristic deliver our opening remarks, setting the stage for a day of inspiration. Following her, Tracy Davidson will take the stage to inspire attendees to rise stronger, reset their focus, and begin breaking through what’s holding them back.

Featured Speakers Include:
Tracy Davidson – Next Level Resilience: What’s Holding You Back from Rising Stronger?
Dr. Kara Ieva – I Am an Emotional Support Human: Practicing SELF-Love at the Next Level
Vernita Bostick – Put Down the Cape: From Superwoman to Sustainable Resilience for Your Next Level
Cassandra Burnett – Silence to Strength: The Power of Being Seen and Heard
Nicole Dubois – From Stuck to Sovereign: Unlearning Fear, Rewriting Your Story, and Rising Anyway

Panel & Workshop Highlights:
The ABCS of Organizational-Wellness – Featuring Brittanie Thomas
Breaking the Cycle: Unlearning the Patterns That Shape Our Lives – Featuring Theresa Santucci, Becky Nieves, Patricia Coughlan & Danielle Roberts. Moderated by Birdia Chambers.
Find Your Spark: What’s Holding You Back – Featuring Krista Collings
Thriving Without a Blueprint: Choosing Yourself at Your Next Level – Featuring Kashmala Khan, Dr. Ali Muller, Dr. Sanaz Shahi, & Dr. Jacqueline Tawney. Moderated by Dr. Emily Cannon.
Dear You: A new, holistic, balanced, & empowered you – Featuring Lynda Smith
Why Not Me? Courageous Moves That Change Everything – Featuring Dr. Joanne Connor, Taruna Chugeria, Elizabeth Jordan & Beatrice Romao. Moderated by Dr. Lakeisha Carter.

This is an event you won’t want to miss! Full-day registration, including breakfast & lunch, is just $49. Can't attend all day? Join us for select sessions for $29 (no meals included).

To register now, visit go.rowan.edu/2026WANConference
